name: scenario_0017
description: The user is planning some upcoming purchases and wants to keep track of specific items they are interested in buying. (UI mode)

amazon.products.name: Sakura Technical pen
amazon.products.description: Fine point technical pen for drawing

amazon.products.name: XingHui BMW M4 die-cast radio-controlled model car

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1
Query: Can you create a new note called 'Shopping List' and add camera, pen, phone, and toy car to it?
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a new note titled 'Shopping List' and add 'camera, pen, phone, toy car' to it. If the assistant asks for clarification or confirms the creation, acknowledge it. Once the note is successfully created with the requested content, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: Actually, let's skip the note, go ahead and delete the 'Shopping List' note you just made. I have pictures of the exact items. Please look up all six of these on Amazon. I want to compare the three cameras in the first three images before I decide which one to buy. Then, add the items shown in the last three images to my Amazon wish list.
Instructions: Tell the assistant that you've changed your mind and want to delete the 'Shopping List' note. Then, direct its attention to the six images and ask it to look up all items on Amazon. When the assistant presents the three cameras with their prices, select the cheapest one and add it to your cart via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant to add the cheapest camera to your cart. Also confirm that the last three items (pen, phone, toy car) should go to your wish list. Once the assistant confirms the note is deleted and all items are placed correctly, end the conversation.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4
  image_6.jpg -> image ID 5

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

task_completion_criteria:
Add the cheapest camera among the Fujifilm X-T4, Fujifilm X100VI, and Leica X2 to the Amazon cart, and add the Sakura Technical pen, Samsung Galaxy Z Flip7, and XingHui BMW M4 die-cast radio-controlled model car to the Amazon wish list.

UI Requirements:
- Round 2: The agent must present the three camera options with their Amazon prices in a structured interactive UI that lets the user select which camera to add to their cart.
